items.heading: Clearing the Civil Services Examination
items.text: Clearing the Civil Services Examination gets you onto a merit list. It does not, by itself, tell you which service you will join.

items.heading: Service and Cadre Are Two
items.text: Service and cadre are two separate decisions, and both matter. Cadre allocation decides which state or group of states you will actually work in for most of your IAS, IPS, or IFoS career.
